description: This file contains utility functions for extracting and handling metadata related to build and test environments in a Yocto Project/OpenEmbedded context, including functions to gather metadata from bitbake, git repositories, and system information.

methods.name: metadata_from_bb
methods.description: Returns test's metadata as an OrderedDict, gathering data via bitbake -e and related functions.

methods.name: metadata_from_data_store
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving metadata from a provided data store.

methods.name: git_rev_info
methods.description: Retrieves git revision information for a given repository path, including branch, commit, and commit count.

methods.name: write_metadata_file
methods.description: Serializes metadata into XML and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: dict_to_XML
methods.description: Recursively converts a dictionary into an XML Element.
